sources.label: Brief (email)
sources.text: Hi! We are Saanjh Studio, a small clothing label from Pune. We need a simple online store for my clothing brand, nothing fancy, just clean and modern. Most customers will buy from phone, so it must look good on mobile. Our budget is ₹15,000. We want to go live before the Diwali sale.

sources.label: WhatsApp thread
sources.text:
[10:02] Saanjh Studio: hi! did you see the brief?
[10:05] Saanjh Studio: also we have around 200 products on Instagram, those need to come on the site
[10:06] Saanjh Studio: UPI and cards both should work
[10:09] Saanjh Studio: my team will send photos, you can add them with the products
[10:12] Saanjh Studio: and small changes later also, like banners for every sale. wo sab bhi aap kar dena
[10:13] Saanjh Studio: total 15k is fine na? my cousin said these sites are easy, jaldi ho jayega
